owned_invariants: screen kills a rule whose pattern is refused or matches any text of a panel of clean texts, and admits the rest with their compiled pattern. A pattern the host does not read is an error that names the rule.

A rule's match in a text (Signal 1) carries the rule's id, its epitope, the matched text and the character offset. The digest of a set of matches is Python's: rows of epitope, text and offset, sorted, written as JSON with every character outside ASCII escaped.

decide gives PASS, DIAGNOSTIC_OR_NORMALIZE or HOLD_OR_REPAIR from the matches and the danger a host check observed (Signal 2). A danger counts only from an observer the caller admits; from another it is ignored and the code says why. A signal that is not independent of the matches is named as UNWITNESSED_DANGER_SIGNAL, TWO_SIGNAL_COLLAPSE or UNREGISTERED_DANGER_KIND.

Observers are compared after trimming white space and lowercasing. A model, an LLM, an agent, a detector or the matcher itself may never be the observer; neither may a danger whose digest is the digest of the matches or whose spans hold a match.

support is the size of the largest set of observations none of which shares a model, scaffold, precedent set or lineage root with another, over the observations that remain once a repeated occurrence or a repeated set of keys is dropped, computed exactly for at most 32 of them. custody is Provisional with a support of three and Candidate otherwise.
boundaries: Observer names are compared by lowercase, where Python case-folds; the two differ at a few characters such as the German sharp s.
Independence here is the correlation keys the caller supplies; the module does not see how an observation was made.
Agreement with Python is shown on hand-computed tables and random observations checked against every subset, not proven.
